You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.8%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 88.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 95.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 82.4%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 40.8%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Home wait_info changes (won 6 of 14), adoption redesigns (won 3 of 6), finish redesigns (won 1 of 2), adoption new_flows (won 1 of 2), sign_in notifications (won 1 of 3), and finish new_screens (won 1 of 5) have proven helpful in winning tests.
Finish hints, sign_in redesigns, sign_in incentives, choose_path layouts, and choose_path redesigns showed no positive effect and frequently caused negative impacts or early test stops.
Adoption hints, choose_path copy, finish layouts, finish new flows, home redesigns, and sign_in copy showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Kinds of change tested only once (adoption new_screen, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint, finish reorder, home new_flow, sign_in hint, sign_in reorder) remain thin evidence.
Predictions were systematically too low for large winning redesigns/flows and too high for changes with no clear effect or negative outcomes.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Habitat Soundscape Info
candidates.change: Adds an interactive ambient habitat sound selector and readiness notification badge to the waiting screen while pet assets generate.
candidates.why: Home wait time is high (median 201s, mean 2336s) and Home wait_info changes have a high historical win rate (6 of 14).

candidates.title: Pick Friend Archetype Interactive Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a stage layout featuring live animated pet trait previews and action selection cards.
candidates.why: Adoption redesigns won 3 out of 6 past tests, and adoption step takes median 89s / mean 1017s.

candidates.title: Home Intro Companion Interaction Guide Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated interactive screen before final entry that guides users through pet desktop controls, hotkeys, and hiding options.
candidates.why: Support mail highlighted 3 issues regarding unclear pet controls/hiding and 4 issues on desktop feature behavior, while finish new_screens won in past tests.

new_desktop_guide.headline: Desktop Pet Control Guide
new_desktop_guide.body: Learn how to summon, move, and hide your pet anywhere on your desktop screen.

components.text: Press Alt+P to show or hide your companion anytime.

candidates.title: Upload Photos Multi-Angle Quality Assessment Flow
candidates.change: Rebuilds the custom pet photo upload step into a step-by-step multi-angle validation flow with dynamic quality preview feedback.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures/visual errors, and adoption new_flows won 1 of 2 in past tests.

candidates.title: Home Intro Split Companion Command Hub Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro screen into a split view combining companion quick-action commands with desktop positioning settings.
candidates.why: Finish redesigns have a positive win record (1 of 2) and finish step conversion drops to 82.4% with mean time 5815s.

candidates.title: Sign-In Multi-Device Account Restore Notification
candidates.change: Adds a sign-in account sync alert clarifying how multi-device pet data and accounts are safely restored upon logging in.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign_in notifications won 1 of 3 past tests.

sign_in.hint: Your saved pets and customizations restore automatically across devices upon sign-in.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Companion Trait Audio Teaser Info
candidates.change: Presents dynamic sound previews of companion voice traits and audio cues while waiting for final pet render completion.
candidates.why: Home wait_info changes hold a 6 of 14 historic win rate, addressing the long wait duration on the waiting screen (mean 2336s).

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Trait Showcase Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new interactive screen before final completion highlighting system tray docking and desktop pet visibility controls.
candidates.why: Support emails show widespread confusion on controlling and hiding pets post-onboarding, and overall onboarding completion is only 40.8%.

new_tray_dock_guide.headline: System Tray & Desktop Docking
new_tray_dock_guide.body: Dock your pet in the system tray or let it wander freely on your screen.

components.text: Right-click the tray icon to quickly access pet options or enter quiet mode.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Companion Pledge Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a checklist layout featuring a pet name commitment pledge and official animated stamp.
candidates.why: Adoption redesigns won 3 out of 6 in previous tests, and adoption completion takes a median 89s.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Companion Activity Checklist Info
candidates.change: Displays a live companion asset preparation checklist and background activity progress display on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Waiting stage duration is very high (median 201s / mean 2336s) and wait_info is the top-performing change type for home step.
